in_hebrew.name: Marji
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Lady of Magdala
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marji הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Aramaic, Marji means 'lady of Magdala'. This name has strong biblical connections, as Marja, Mary Magdalene, was a prominent follower of Jesus Christ in the New Testament. She is remembered for her faith, devotion, and loyalty to Jesus, making this name an excellent choice for parents seeking to instill these virtues in their child.
